Based on the provided abstract, the study explores how responsible AI can be integrated into ESG investment analyses and addresses the gap in the AI auditing literature regarding the role of investors. While the findings note that this is not yet an established practice and identify several challenges (e.g., investor awareness, lack of standardized metrics, and knowledge asymmetry), the evidence concludes that AI is recognized as a material issue and that its incorporation into ESG evaluations is justified. This supports the hypothesis that ESG analyses can serve as a viable tool for ethics-based AI auditing and governance.
